versions.content: Prototype of a ParameterSwComponentType can be mapped to more than one ECU A prototype of a ParameterSwComponent- Type can be mapped to more than one ECU. This is required, because this special component does not communicate over the network, so that a copy of the prototype has to be created on each ECU were it is required.
